units.source_text: 奏乐之处甚远，不易听得清楚。

en.t: The place where the music was being played was very far away, so it was hard to hear clearly.

units.source_text: 皇上便命取过各种乐器来。

en.t: The Emperor then ordered various musical instruments to be brought over.

units.source_text: 于是兵部卿亲王弹琵琶，内大臣弹和琴。

en.t: Then the Prince Minister of War played the biwa, and the Minister of the Center played the wagon.
The koto was respectfully presented to the Suzaku Retired Emperor.

units.source_text: 七弦琴照例赐与太政大臣。

en.t: The seven-stringed kin was bestowed, as usual, upon the Grand Minister.

units.source_text: 诸人都是盖世无双的名手，各尽所能，合奏妙曲，美不可言。

en.t: All of them were peerless masters, and each gave the best of his skill; together they played exquisite music beyond words.

units.source_text: 许多善于唱歌的殿上人随侍在侧，

en.t: Many courtiers skilled at singing were in attendance nearby,

units.source_text: 他们便歌唱催马乐《安名尊》，

en.t: and they sang the saibara song Anato,
then next they sang Sakurabito as well.

units.source_text: 月亮朦胧地出现，中岛一带地方都点起篝火来。

en.t: The moon appeared hazily, and bonfires were lit all around the central island.
The imperial outing came to an end.
